plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first checkpoint of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan built around simple full-body strength, power, and supportive conditioning with bodyweight-only training. Week 1 establishes baseline performance on the main monitored lifts so future progress is easier to judge, and the main build starts in Week 2. With only 2 S&C sessions per week and a beginner profile, the plan keeps exercise choices safe, clear, and repeatable while still giving you enough conditioning work to support boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic whole-body strength, simple explosive ability, and repeatable conditioning with low-complexity bodyweight work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power patterns with slightly harder variations while keeping recovery in line with boxing training.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen fast bodyweight output, and express cleaner sport-relevant speed without excess fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast and high as you can. Land softly and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the squat jump feels awkward. Keep the dip short and the landing quiet.

exercises.name: 1b. Kneeling Chest Pass to Wall
exercises.notes: Throw hard from the chest with full intent. Use a towel ball or soft household object only if it is safe and rebounds predictably.

substitutionOptions.name: Explosive Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no safe throwing option is available. Push the floor away fast and keep reps crisp.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: This set establishes your starting point for future progress. Use strict form, full body tension, chest close to the floor, and stop before your technique breaks.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best strict rep count with clean form so we can track progress across the block.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard all-out set while stopping with about 1 rep left in reserve. Log the total clean reps to establish your baseline.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, box, or sturdy surface if floor push-ups are not yet clean.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lower and stand up hard. Keep the front foot flat and the torso tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squat setup feels uncomfortable. Step back softly and keep balance.

exercises.name: 4. Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.notes: Lift with control and keep the neck relaxed. Focus on clean shoulder blade movement, not speed.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Press the low back into the floor and breathe behind the brace. Shorten the lever if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold is too hard to keep clean. Move slowly and keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: 6. Fast Feet In Place
exercises.notes: Stay light and relaxed. Work 8 rounds of 20 seconds fast, 40 seconds easy.

substitutionOptions.name: Shadowboxing Intervals
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you prefer more boxing-specific conditioning. Keep the hands sharp and footwork clean.

exercises.name: 1a. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Cover a small distance and stick each landing. Stay athletic and balanced rather than chasing max width.

substitutionOptions.name: Lateral Line Hop
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg landings are not yet stable. Keep contacts quick and controlled.

exercises.name: 1b. Rotational Wall Throw
exercises.notes: Turn through the hips and trunk and throw with speed. Keep the feet grounded and the finish balanced.

substitutionOptions.name: Shadowboxing Power Cross
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no safe throwing setup is available. Throw each cross hard with full hip turn and reset between reps.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.reps: AMRAP each side leaving 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: This set establishes your starting point for future progress. Use bodyweight only, keep the range consistent, and stop before balance or knee tracking breaks.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log reps for each leg with the same setup so we can compare later weeks accurately.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy reps each side, then perform one hard set per leg while stopping with about 1 rep left in reserve. Log reps for both sides to establish your baseline.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the elevated version is too unstable. Keep the same stance each set.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Lower under control and push the floor away hard. Keep the hips high and the head moving forward slightly as you descend.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Pike Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench or box if full floor reps are too difficult.

exercises.name: 4. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Pull hard against an anchored towel only if the setup is completely solid and safe. Keep the chest tall and squeeze the upper back.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorframe Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a sturdy doorframe and pull with control. Do not jerk into position.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stack the body in a straight line and keep the hips lifted. Breathe slowly and do not let the shoulders shrug.

exercises.name: 6. Tempo Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Stay smooth and technical. Work 6 rounds of 2 minutes at steady pace with 1 minute easy walk and breathing between rounds.

endurancePrescription.format: 6 x 2 minutes work / 1 minute easy recovery

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Every rep should be fast and crisp. Rest enough to keep the jump height consistent.

exercises.name: 1b. Explosive Push-Up
exercises.notes: Drive up fast and keep the body straight. Stop the set if speed drops or you start snaking through the torso.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Regular Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if leaving the floor is not yet clean. Move fast on the way up and stay controlled on the way down.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use strict reps and stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. Elevate the hands if needed so every set stays clean.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your strongest clean set and only progress reps if form stays solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor reps fall short of the target range.

substitutionOptions.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if regular push-ups are too easy while still keeping shoulder comfort.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the descent, pause briefly at the bottom, then stand up with intent. Keep the front knee tracking over the foot.

exercises.name: 4. Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.notes: Move slowly and keep the range you can control. These should wake up the upper back, not strain the neck.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the ribs down and the low back flat. Shorten the hold if you lose the position.

exercises.name: 6. Fast Feet In Place
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed through the shoulders and keep the feet quick. Work 10 rounds of 20 seconds hard, 40 seconds easy.

exercises.name: 1a. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Stick the landing for a full second before the next rep. Stay low and balanced.

exercises.name: 1b. Shadowboxing Power Cross
exercises.notes: Throw every punch with intent, then fully reset. Keep the shoulders loose and the hips doing the work.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use bodyweight only and stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. Keep the stance and depth consistent on both legs.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the strongest clean set on each leg with the same setup and depth.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if balance limits the quality of the elevated version.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Move under control and finish each rep with a strong lockout. Keep 1-2 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 4. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Build tension smoothly and hold the chest tall. Do not use this if the anchor point is questionable.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep the top hip stacked and stay long through the neck. Stop early if position slips.

exercises.name: 6. Tempo Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Work at a steady pace you can sustain while staying technical. Perform 7 rounds of 2 minutes with 1 minute easy recovery.

endurancePrescription.format: 7 x 2 minutes work / 1 minute easy recovery

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Keep the dip short and the takeoff violent. End the set if the jumps stop looking springy.

exercises.name: 1b. Explosive Push-Up
exercises.notes: Attack the floor and separate the hands slightly if you can do it cleanly. Keep the torso rigid.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Accumulate quality reps and stop with 1 rep in reserve on the last 1-2 sets. Raise the hands if you cannot keep full range.

performanceTarget.prompt: Try to beat Week 2 with one more clean rep while keeping the same standard.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a smooth lower, slight pause, then stand fast. Keep your balance and avoid rushing through sloppy reps.

exercises.name: 4. Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.notes: Lift only as high as you can control. Keep the shoulders down and away from the ears.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Rock
exercises.notes: Stay rounded through the trunk and keep the movement small. Regress to a hold if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the rocking version breaks your shape.

exercises.name: 6. Fast Feet In Place
exercises.notes: Push the pace but stay relaxed in the face and shoulders. Work 12 rounds of 20 seconds hard, 40 seconds easy.

exercises.name: 1a. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Own each landing before the next jump. Keep the distance honest and the quality high.

exercises.name: 1b. Shadowboxing Power Cross
exercises.notes: Each punch should be fast and sharp with a full reset. Do not turn this into a flurry.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Stay upright, hit the same depth, and leave 1 rep in reserve on most sets. If balance slips, switch to regular split squats.

performanceTarget.prompt: Aim to improve your best clean set from Week 2 without changing the setup.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Control the lower and drive up hard. Stop before the range shortens or the hips sag.

exercises.name: 4. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Pull hard and keep the body braced. Only use a setup that feels completely secure.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank With Top-Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Keep the hips high and the body stacked. Use a regular side plank if this version shakes apart.

substitutionOptions.name: Side Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the top-leg raise takes you out of position.

exercises.name: 6. Tempo Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Move continuously, breathe through the nose when possible, and keep technique tidy. Perform 8 rounds of 2 minutes with 1 minute easy recovery.

endurancePrescription.format: 8 x 2 minutes work / 1 minute easy recovery

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Keep every rep snappy and stop well before fatigue. This week is for freshness, not chasing more volume.

exercises.name: 1b. Explosive Push-Up
exercises.notes: Move fast and crisp with full control. If speed drops, end the set there.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve on every set. Clean reps only and no grinding.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat

exercises.name: 4. Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.notes: Keep the movement easy and precise. Stop before neck tension builds.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Hold a clean shape and breathe steadily. End the set when the low back starts to lift.

exercises.name: 6. Fast Feet In Place
exercises.notes: Keep the feet lively but do not redline. Work 6 rounds of 20 seconds fast, 40 seconds easy.

exercises.name: 1a. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Stick every landing and keep the contacts clean. Do not force extra distance this week.

exercises.name: 1b. Shadowboxing Power Cross
exercises.notes: Sharp single shots with a full reset each time. Stay fast and relaxed.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve and keep the movement smooth. If balance feels off, switch to regular split squats.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track one clean comfortable set per leg so we can compare against the harder weeks.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use controlled reps and keep some room in the tank. No grinding this week.

exercises.name: 4. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Build tension smoothly and hold posture. Keep effort solid but not maximal.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stay long through the body and breathe calmly. Keep this crisp and easy.

exercises.name: 6. Tempo Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Use this as light technical conditioning. Perform 5 rounds of 2 minutes with 1 minute easy recovery.

endurancePrescription.format: 5 x 2 minutes work / 1 minute easy recovery
